properties.name: rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Enable rate limiting on authentication endpoints

properties.name: rate-limit.trust-forwarded-headers
properties.description: Use the first X-Forwarded-For address as the client key (only behind a trusted proxy)

properties.name: rate-limit.login.max-requests
properties.description: Maximum login and OTP login requests per client within the window

properties.name: rate-limit.login.window
properties.description: Window length for the login and OTP login rate limit

properties.name: rate-limit.otp.max-requests
properties.description: Maximum OTP generation requests per client within the window

properties.name: rate-limit.otp.window
properties.description: Window length for the OTP generation rate limit

properties.name: rate-limit.password-reset.max-requests
properties.description: Maximum password reset verification and reset requests per client within the window

properties.name: rate-limit.password-reset.window
properties.description: Window length for the password reset verification and reset rate limit
